followup: neither role negative/indeterminate, at least one positive, no catastrophic/integrity regression
negative: new per-example catastrophic failure, worse evidence, any lower contract rate, new truncation or lower exact semantic mean
neutral: no regression and equal exact semantic mean
positive: all tuned catastrophic counts zero; no contract, truncation or evidence regression; exact role semantic mean strictly greater
semantic_formula: unchanged DEV role arithmetic score applied to protected outputs
